faq.how-do-i-report-a-result: How do I report a result?
faq.how-do-i-report-a-result-a: At your polling unit, once the result sheet (EC8A) is announced, tap Report, choose your unit and take the photos the app asks for. The Observer Guide walks through every step. Try a practice run first — nothing you enter there counts.
